patterns.note: Asymmetrical, highly spaced speaker grid that places names in a sparse, staggered three-column layout with massive vertical gaps instead of standard cards.
Low-contrast, highly disciplined sans-serif typography that relies on precise alignment and generous whitespace rather than oversized display weights.
A warm, sophisticated cream background paired with stark black interactive elements and thin, vibrant primary/secondary colored vector lines.
Generative canvas-based line art at the top and bottom of the page that animates smoothly, morphing mathematical curves to spell 'COMPILE' and rotate geometric shapes.
Ultra-minimalist form fields with thin borders, flat solid black buttons, and zero border-radius, blending seamlessly into the background.

technique_notes: To recreate the hero animation, use an HTML5 Canvas element driven by parametric equations (like Lissajous curves) to render smooth, multi-colored vector paths that morph continuously.
Build the speaker list using CSS Grid with explicit column spans and empty rows to create a staggered, airy 'constellation' layout that avoids standard card containers.
Maintain a strict flat aesthetic by removing all box-shadows, gradients, and border-radii, relying entirely on solid fills and thin lines for UI boundaries.

design_tokens.type_scale: Balanced, low-contrast sans-serif hierarchy with uniform weights, relying on generous whitespace rather than extreme scale shifts.
design_tokens.spacing: extremely airy and sparse, utilizing massive vertical gaps and asymmetrical grid placements to create an editorial, exclusive feel

standout: The use of generative, multi-colored mathematical canvas curves to spell out the event name 'COMPILE' and anchor the interactive sections, combined with an ultra-sparse, staggered speaker grid.
